name: Muse Voice Transcribe 1.0
description: Muse Voice Transcribe 1.0 is Meta's real-time audio perception model for multilingual speech recognition, speaker diarization, and endpointing. It supports seamless code-switching, keyword and language biasing, audio longer than one hour when streamed, and more than 20 speakers.

details.name: availability
details.value: Available through Meta Model API as a realtime WebSocket endpoint and a one-shot transcription endpoint.

details.name: language_coverage
details.value: Trained with more than 70 languages; Meta recommends 25 extensively validated languages at launch.

details.name: api_limits
details.value: Realtime sessions support up to 60 minutes. The one-shot endpoint accepts at most 10 minutes or 32 MB per request.

sources.notes: Launch date, architecture, languages, diarization, endpointing, code-switching, and long-context capabilities.
Official Meta cookbook documents the model ID, one-shot and realtime endpoints, formats, modes, and limits.

verification.notes: Release metadata and API contract verified against Meta's launch post and official model cookbook.
